subject: Re: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up Acme Health (HIPAA/BAA/SOC2)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priya Singh <p.singh@acmehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up Acme Health (HIPAA/BAA/SOC2)

Hi Tom / Priya,

Thanks again for the call earlier  great context on Acme's roadmap and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from the call:
- Primary concern: handling PHI and meeting audit requirements for clinical integrations.
- Compliance gates: BAA required, SOC2 Type II evidence preferred, longer-term audit retention for logs.
- Network preference: your security team mentioned preference for private VPC or on-prem options if we can meet encryption/audit controls; hosted API would need strong contractual and technical mitigations.

Redwood deployment options we discussed (short):
- Hosted API: fastest to production but limited control over network boundaries; we can support a BAA plus contractual controls, and have SOC2 Type II attestation.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): dedicated GPU pools and stronger isolation  good middle-ground if you need tenancy isolation without full VPC control.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): greatest control for PHI, supports customer-managed networking and integration with KMS/HSM; used by customers with strict audit/regulatory needs.

Requested from your side to help us recommend the right path:
1) Confirm deployment preference (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
2) Please share the security contact (name/email) who will own the architecture review and any compliance questionnaires.
3) Any specific retention/audit window requirements (e.g., logs retained 3 vs 7 years) or encryption requirements beyond standard AES-256 at rest.

Next steps (proposed):
- I'll share our SOC2 Type II attestation and a draft BAA for legal review.
- If you prefer Private/VPC, we'll schedule an architecture review with our SRE/security team to walk through networking, KMS integration, and audit log exports.
- If Dedicated is acceptable, we can scope estimated capacity and deployment SOW.

Attaching: BAA draft (BAA-Draft-v2.docx) and SOC2 attestation stub (SOC2-Type2-Attestation-2026.pdf)  happy to provide the full reports under NDA if needed.

Would love a short reply confirming the security contact and preferred deployment mode so we can lock in the right internal resources.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Tom Jenkins <tjenkins@acmehealth.com>

Date: 2027-06-30T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up Acme Health (HIPAA/BAA/SOC2)

Marissa  

Thanks for the recap and for sending the attestation/BAA. Quick answers from our side after syncing with security: 

- Deployment preference: Private VPC is our preference for anything touching PHI. We may evaluate Dedicated if Private is cost-prohibitive, but the expectation from compliance is that we control network boundaries and KMS.
- Must-haves: BAA signed, SOC2 Type II attestation, encryption at rest (customer KMS preferred), audit logging with export capability. Retention: we need audit logs available for up to 7 years for select clinical workflows (we can surface specific requirements in the questionnaire).

Can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS in Private deployments (we need to store keys in our KMS/HSM)? Also please confirm the types of audit logs you can export (token-level, request/response metadata, user identifiers masked) and retention/export formats.

Our security lead is Priya Singh (cc'd)  she will own the architecture review. Priya, can we set a 60-minute call next week to walk the architecture and review the SOC2 artifacts + BAA? Our preferred windows: Tue 7/6 or Wed 7/7 morning PST.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the docs.

 Tom
Director of Integrations | Acme Health
Tom.Jenkins@acmehealth.com

- Share BAA draft (attached) and create a DocuSign envelope if legal wants to proceed.

Technical notes for the call:
- Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS for VPC deployments; we integrate via standard KMIP/AWS KMS APIs depending on customer infra.
- Audit logs: we can export token-level and request metadata to an S3-compatible endpoint or push to your SIEM; retention policies are configurable per-customer (we can retain for 7+ years on archived buckets).

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-Attestation-2026.pdf, BAA-Draft-v2.docx

I'll propose Tue 7/6 10:00am PST and Wed 7/7 9:00am PST for the architecture review to Priya. If either works for Acme, I'll send calendar invites and include our SRE (Dylan) and Solutions Security (me).
